instruction: Prepare next week's board meeting. Our Notion 'Board Brief Template' page lists the standard agenda sections: Approvals, Financials, and Risks. In Google Docs, create the 'Board Meeting Agenda - June' document whose body includes all three of those section headings. Schedule the board meeting itself as a Google Calendar event titled 'Board Meeting' on June 30. Then post in #general that the board agenda is drafted and the meeting is on the calendar.
instruction_zh: 准备下周的董事会会议。我们的 Notion 'Board Brief Template' 页面列出了标准议程章节：Approvals、Financials 和 Risks。在 Google Docs 中创建名为 'Board Meeting Agenda - June' 的文档，正文包含这三个章节标题。将董事会会议本身安排为 Google Calendar 日程，标题为 'Board Meeting'，日期为 June 30。然后在 #general 中发布消息，说明董事会议程已起草完毕，且会议已安排在日历上。
persona: You are an office worker acting as a project lead. Your tools for this task are: shared documents, the Notion workspace, the team calendar, team communications.
context: Initial environment (seeded via a single shared session id across all mocks): Google Docs with documents 'Board Agenda - May'; Notion workspace with pages 'Board Brief Template'; an empty Google Calendar; Slack workspace with channels #general, #random. GROUND TRUTH — the agent earns partial credit for each checkpoint: new June board agenda doc (+0.2); agenda has the template's 3 sections (+0.3); cal_new_event (+0.1); Board Meeting event (+0.1); on June 30 (+0.2); slack_new_msg (+0.1). Scoring is absolute over each mock's current_state; new objects exclude the seeded IDs, so an untouched environment scores 0.0 and fully completing every checkpoint scores 1.0.
